OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: OpenCTI observable types for which to enable the enrichment.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: Only perform enrichment for observables with this TLP level or less restrictive.

OCD_ENRICH_DATALAKE_TOKEN.description: Long Term Token used to access Orange Cyberdefense Datalake API.

OCD_ENRICH_IGNORE_UNSCORED_INDICATORS.description: If `true`, Datalake indicators that do not have any score will be ignored.

OCD_ENRICH_IGNORE_WHITELISTED_INDICATORS.description: If `true`, Datalake indicators that are whitelisted will be ignored.

OCD_ENRICH_FALLBACK_SCORE.description: If `OCD_ENRICH_IGNORE_UNSCORED_INDICATORS` is set to `false`, this value will be used as a default for Datalake indicators without any score.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_TAGS_AS_LABELS.description: Whether to add Datalake tags as labels to the enriched observable.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_SCORES_AS_LABELS.description: Whether to add Datalake threat scores as labels to the enriched observable.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_TLP.description: Whether to add a TLP marking to the enriched observable (overwrite existing).

OCD_ENRICH_THREAT_ACTOR_AS_INTRUSION_SET.description: Whether to transform Datalake 'Threat Actor' objects into 'Intrusion Set' objects.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_SCORE.description: Whether to add score to the enriched observable (overwrite existing).

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_EXTREF.description: Whether to add external references to the enriched observable.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_SUMMARY.description: Whether to add a threat summary as a note to the enriched observable.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_RELATED.description: Whether to import objects from the Threat Library related to this observable, such as indicators, malwares, etc.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_SIGHTINGS.description: Whether to import positive sightings from Datalake.

OCD_ENRICH_ADD_CREATEDBY.description: Whether to add a reference to 'Orange Cyberdefense' organization as author of OpenCTI objects.

OCD_ENRICH_CURATE_LABELS.description: Adapt Datalake CTI tags as STIX labels.
